claim.summary: Hittite society included institutional non-free and dependent categories that should not all be collapsed into slavery. The legal corpus distinguishes free and non-free persons, while specialist synthesis identifies government-managed groups including deportees, 'taken ones' (probably prisoners of war) and craftsmen.

territorial_practice.notes: P3 refers to the institutionalized dependent categories described for the Hittite polity; it is separate from the narrower slavery claim.
